contract: E11: Config.Board (Enabled false until the board window ships). BoardAction(board, Open | Take | Reroll, slot, Kind | Sneaky) within Range of the board spot; 4 cards per board from J1..J10 with the field's values (J7 only after Auto Battle is unlocked; the woods always keep J6 / J10, outside PvP); carry 3; a taken / swapped card gets a template that is neither on the board nor one of its last two; one swap per 60 s. Jobs are judged by StoryQuestService.EventAmount (J10: seconds in one go at the gate); a finished job pays at once HuntValue(board level, 1), half after 10 a KST day, the 5th of a day adds one 30% scroll, counts the side in data.Story.N (no honor / infamy / ranking) and says which way the shard leaned. JobRows = Kind 'Job' rows (+ the 'Job Board' hint after M1_4 until the first job). A broken save is cleaned at load.
limitations: The board model, prompt and window are game dev 1's (remote contract in the doc); QuestService's extras switch is tested in test_a23_14. Real walking and the 1 s loop timing are modelled by moving the root and stepping the loop.
